definitions.first_chance: First-chance attempt: a field-goal attempt before the shooting team's first offensive rebound of the possession.
definitions.made: Made points: 2 or 3 for a make, per attempt. And-one free throws are not included.
definitions.second: Second chances: every point the shooting team scores later in the same possession after a miss (putbacks and free throws included), per attempt. A miss the defence rebounds adds nothing.
definitions.own: Own scoring: made points plus second chances, per attempt.
definitions.cost: Opponent cost: how many more (plus) or fewer (minus) points than the season's league average the opponent scores on its very next possession, weighted by how often a make and a defensively rebounded miss happen. Minus is a benefit to the shooting team.
definitions.net: Scoring minus cost: own scoring minus opponent cost, per attempt.
definitions.ppp: Opponent points per possession: points on the opponent's next possession, including its own offensive rebounds, after a make or after a defensive rebound.
definitions.league: League points per possession: all counted possessions of the season, both teams.
definitions.views: All attempts: per first-chance attempt. After a miss: per first-chance miss (second chances and the cost of the defensive-rebound branch). After a defensive rebound: per miss the defence rebounded.
definitions.zones: Rim: layups, dunks, tips, alley-oops, putbacks and finger rolls, and any 2 from 4 feet or closer (the shot label decides first). Short mid: other 2s from 5 to 14 feet. Long mid: other 2s from 15 feet out. Three: every 3.
definitions.positions: Estimated positions: guards (PG, SG), forwards (SF, PF) and bigs (C), from CourtLens's estimate for the season, built from listed position, size and box-score rates.
definitions.interval: 95% interval from resampling whole games 2,000 times within the season. It covers game sampling only, not position-estimate or matching error.
definitions.thin: Thin: fewer than 100 attempts, or fewer than 50 opponent possessions behind the cost. Values are served unsmoothed and never coloured.
definitions.colour: Green or red only on an opponent cost whose 95% interval excludes zero: green below the league average, red above it.

limitations: Descriptive, not causal, not a net rating and not shot-selection advice.
Cost covers the opponent's immediate possession only: after an offensive rebound, the opponent possession that eventually follows is not counted.
A fouled miss is not a field-goal attempt, so it is outside the sample; and-one free throws are not in made points.
Positions are estimates, and centres are the least accurate group.
Games the sealed possessions excluded are unknown and out of every value.
The opponent's possession after a make usually starts from an inbound, so the after-make comparison with the all-possession average carries that start.
responses.credit: The views, zones, first chance and cost formula follow Databallr's Shot Aftermath page. CourtLens computes them from its own sealed NBA play-by-play possessions, so its numbers are its own. Data: NBA play-by-play and shot charts via shufinskiy/nba_data.
